info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Meetings Meetings Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Meetings API allows users to efficiently manage scheduled meetings by providing the capability to cancel them as needed. This endpoint is essential for organizations that require flexibility in their meeting schedules and want to minimize confusion caused by cancellations. Typical consumers include administrative personnel and team leaders who manage meeting logistics. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their meeting management processes and ensure smoother communication within teams.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously scheduled meeting. Upon successful cancellation, the meeting will no longer occur.

requestBody.description: Request body for cancelling a meeting. This body must include the relevant identifiers to specify which meeting is to be cancelled. Ensure that the data conforms to the expected schema to process the cancellation smoothly.

202.description: Request accepted for asynchronous processing of cancellation.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelRequest.description: A request body schema for canceling meetings. This schema accepts a string message that describes the cancellation reason.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_202.title: Meeting Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the meeting after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_202.description: Schema representing the response for the cancellation of a meeting operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who initiated the cancellation operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation operation was created, typically in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information related to the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
